title: Orbito Interface Architecture and Workspace UX Stabilization
objective: Improve the existing Orbito interface architecture and user experience without disrupting backend contracts, eliminating redundant controls and enforcing strict anti-boxiness.
context: The baseline established multi-tab terminal workspaces and developer UI. The frontend specialist must inspect existing components, eliminate duplicated navigation and redundant toolbar buttons, enforce clean typography (no pill backgrounds on counts), and improve contextual empty states.
priorities: Eliminate redundant interface elements and duplicated functionality
Improve navigation, workspace composition and visual hierarchy
Enforce strict Anti-Boxiness (Rule 4 in AGENTS.md): borderless layout, no boxed pill counts
Icon-only toolbar and header controls with hover tooltips (title and aria-label)
Improve terminal and project explorer integration and empty states
Standardize visual components and interaction consistency
Improve accessibility and keyboard shortcut navigation
expected_deliverables: Concise UI/UX audit report documenting existing redundancies and planned refinements
Cleaned workspace composition with borderless layouts and refined typographic hierarchy
Strictly icon-only toolbars with title/aria-label tooltips across tabs and workspace headers
Cleaned badge and count displays (no rounded background boxes on numbers)
Passing test suite and zero typecheck errors
Completed HANDOFF.md with UI verification evidence
acceptance_criteria: Typecheck passes (0 errors across node and web targets)
Relevant UI and component tests pass without regressions
Existing functionality remains available (no accidental feature deletion)
Strict compliance with AGENTS.md Rule 4 (Anti-boxiness, borderless cards, icon-only toolbars, clean typography on counts)
Zero modifications to main process or unauthorized backend files
No unauthorized modifications to protected shared contracts (src/shared/**, package.json)
Handoff submission created at .agents/coordination/agents/frontend/HANDOFF.md with UI verification notes

risk_assessment.mitigation: Do not redesign everything blindly. Inspect the entire application first and preserve all working functionality. UI changes must not break backend IPC bindings.

evidence_required: UI verification notes detailing eliminated redundancies
